notes.title: Version 1.3: The Exploration Update
notes.content:
This update adds the following content:
[olist]
Exploration

The player will have an unfilled mini-map for each level

Find the ancient artifact in each level to reveal the map's contents

Castle garden expansion

An extra room was added to the castle garden

Progression Changes

The rewards earned from the slot machine will be kept across runs

Four new achievements to unlock!

Modifications to camera behavior and bug fixes
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 1.2.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed map generation glitch in Forest level that caused some runs to have half the rooms

Removed deceptive exits in Forest level

Re-mapped default controls for the UI based off of player feedback

Improved the character selection UI

notes.title: Cutscene music & quality of life changes
notes.content:
Added a new track to the introduction cutscene
 Added skip buttons in all non-essential cutscenes
 Various bug fixes

notes.title: Dialog & Day-Night Cycle Fix
notes.content:
Fixed two issues:

 Day-night cycle was seeding incorrectly and persisting to indoor levels.
 Dungeon boss dialog box display issue

notes.title: Version 1.2 - The Challenge Mode Update
notes.content:
A new update for Blade and Burden is here, bringing the following features!

[olist]
 Unforgiving Mode - The ultimate challenge mode for veteran players, it limits you to one heart with no items. 
 Boss Rush - Don't care for normal enemies, puzzles, and all that? Cut straight to the action with back to back boss fights.
 Level Select - Choose where your start your journey by being able to choose from any of the four areas.
 New Achievements! I'll let you figure those out on your own.

Boss Rush & Level Select are only available after completing the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes February 1
notes.content:
Tweaked hitbox sizes for hellhounds
 Fixed audio issue on Mac

notes.title: Update Notes January 18
notes.content:
[olist]
 Objective UI glitch displaying incorrect information fixed
 Lava hitbox fixed on the Satan boss fight level
 Shop listing issues remedied
[/olist]

notes.title: New Demo Version Released
notes.content:
Ahead of Steam Next Fest, which starts this coming Monday, an updated version of the demo has been released!

This new version contains the following changes/additions:


 Story Content: More dialog and story content has been included to give players more of a taste of the journeys each of the characters will embark on.
 Updated Visuals: The UI has been updated to include more objective details, character fly ins in the main menu, and timers for special abilities.
 Bug Fixes: Visual and gameplay bugs such as collision issues have been resolved.


Have fun!
